about_the_game:
You will have to take on the roles of medieval heroes and live their stories. Betrayals, intrigues, love, brotherhood and loyalty.

Uncover the secrets of an unusual universe on behalf of different characters. Each Story will unite heroes in the fight against cruel enemies and shed light on world events.

Control the characters:

  • warriors - from classic guards to engineers, who are at ‘you’ with siege tools and mechanisms;

  • mages with all the inherent madness;

  • weasels-likely to go into the shadows and affect the morale of fellow soldiers and enemies;

  • druids who live in the woods and can talk to animals and spirits of the elements.

Game Features:

  • Individualised pumping of each character with a choice of skills and play style.

  • Advanced combat system with lots of tactical and strategic choices.

  • Grey morality and story choices that can change this world.
